notes.title: My Grandpa's Haunted House is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017057/790333ded9d21fb050514d8d603107c5284a16b8.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

The wait is over! I am proudly presenting my new 50th title called My Grandpa's Haunted House which is now available on Steam! If you are into 2D Survival horror games then, this might be the game for you.

[h1]Check it out now:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2870070/My_Grandpas_Haunted_House/


Please give this game a try. Your feedback is valuable to me. So, please let me know if you encounter issues.

There is a huge discount on [b]Indie Horror Games Bundle #2[/b] for celebrating the release of my 50th project called My Grandpa's Haunted House game on Steam and if you would like to purchase multiple horror games at a huge discount then this is your chance.

[h1]Get Indie Horror Games Bundle #2 here:[/h1] https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33469/Indie_Horror_Games_Bundle_2/

Thanks to everyone who have been supporting me on Steam! Creating and releasing this game on Steam would have never been possible without your support.

I hope you will enjoy the game. Happy Gaming!

Best Regards,
Anamik

notes.title: Update #1 - Broken Achievement Fixed!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This is to inform you that the broken achievement "Level 22" has been fixed and you should be able to unlock it without issues. Thank you for letting me know about the bug! Please feel free to let me know if you encounter further issues and I will try my best to solve them as soon as possible. 

This is the Day 1 update and more updates will be available in the future based on the feedback received from the players. Thank you very much for giving this game a chance! I hope you will enjoy it.

Best Regards,
Anamik
